title: TCM-5CEVAL: EXTENDED DEEP EVALUATION BENCHMARK FOR LLM’S COMPREHENSIVE CLINICAL RESEARCH COMPETENCE IN TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE

bias_targets.methodology: The paper uses a permutation-based consistency test for single-choice questions, where the sequence of options (A-E) is cyclically rotated so each original option appears in every position exactly once. The model's answers are evaluated across all five permutations to determine if its predictions are invariant to the order of the options, thereby measuring robustness against option-order bias.
